## Checklist

### General
- [ ] **Self-Reviewed** - Code reviewed for logic and correctness.
- [ ] **AI-Reviewed** - Code reviewed by co-pilot.
- [ ] **Self-Tested** - Did Self test.
- [ ] **Documented** - README, API docs, CHANGELOG, ENV-EXAMPLE updated.
- [ ] **Security Verified** - No secrets, credentials, or vulnerabilities.
- [ ] **No Breaking Changes** - Backwards compatible or clearly documented.
- [ ] **Migration** - Added and tested migration with sample data.
- [ ] **Dependencies Clean** - No unnecessary additions, lock files updated.
- [ ] **Builds Successfully** - No merge conflicts, compiles and runs.
- [ ] **Performance** - Performance impact reviewed.
- [ ] **Server/Loader** - Service import is checked on all loader files.

### Client / UI
- [ ] Change is compatible in both dark and light theme.
- [ ] UI changes match design or UX expectations.
- [ ] Responsive behavior verified.
- [ ] No console errors or warnings.
- [ ] Existing is not affected by the new change on components.
